mapper.insert: insert ignore into user_chapter_read(user_id, book_id, chapter_id, sort_id) values (#{userId}, #{bookId}, #{chapterId}, #{sortId});
mapper.update: update user_chapter_read set state=1 where chapter_id=#{chapterId}
mapper.select: select count(*) from user_chapter_read where user_id=#{userId} and book_id=#{bookId} and state=0
